# proxmox_user_tfa_entries (Data Source)

Lists the TFA entries of one user from `/access/tfa/{userid}`, sorted by creation time. Secrets are not exposed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_user_tfa_entries" "root" {
  user_id = "root@pam"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `user_id` (String) User in `name@realm` form.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String)
- `enable` (Boolean)
- `entry_id` (String)
- `type` (String)
